sections.title: What's new
items: Albums, Artists and Genres can show as a list as well as a grid: the grid and list switch sits at the top right of each page. The grid's cards come in three sizes, S, M and L. Each page remembers its own choice.
In the list, click a column's heading to sort by it, and click it again to reverse it, like on Tracks. In the grid, the By tabs sort the same way. Each page remembers its sort.
Albums show their record label, and Artists show the label of their newest album and the year they started (from Roon, or from MusicBrainz through Wrapped's tagging). The filters find labels too.

Tracks has a Columns button with a switch for every column. New columns: Track number, Album artist, Composer, Format, Dynamic range, Plays, Last played and File name. Every column sorts from its heading.
Turn on the wrench, then drag a heading onto another to move its column there. Reset order puts them back. It works on Tracks, and on Albums, Artists and Genres in list view.

Genres are tiles sized by how much of your library they hold, biggest first, with their pictures tinted in your accent color. The top half of a tile opens its sub-genres in a panel under it, and theirs inside that, as deep as they go; the bottom half opens the genre. In list view the genre's name opens its sub-genres under it and the rest of the row opens the genre. Genres with nothing of yours in them are left out.
A new Genres card in Wrapped's Settings picks whose genres the Genres page shows: Wrapped's own (from the tags it keeps for your artists) or Roon's, with Roon's pictures and sub-genres.

Wrapped's genres now nest: melodic death metal sits under death metal, metalcore and grindcore under metal, darksynth under synthwave, and so on. A genre's counts and its page take in its sub-genres' artists.
A genre's page now opens to the artists and albums in your library, in grid or list, with a filter and sorting. Roon's top and recommended picks for it are on their own tab.

Artists show the same pictures as Roon, logos included, and hundreds of pictures that didn't load before now do. For artists Roon has no picture of, Wrapped looks on Deezer and uses its picture when that artist has one of your albums or songs.
Artists sort the way Roon sorts them, so "The Beatles" is under B and ":wumpscut:" under W.
On Tracks the heart is its own column: it sorts by hearted, moves like the others, and can be switched off in Columns.

sections.title: Fixes
items: The taskbar widget, the toasts and the Enable Wrapper button no longer show up in the taskbar or in Alt+Tab.
The button sits next to the minimize button in Roon's title bar, out of the way of the title.
A library shuffle on the Tracks page carries on after Toasted restarts, as long as its songs are still in the zone's queue.

sections.title: Good to know
items: Labels, start years and the new Tracks columns fill in after one more Read the library, in Wrapped's Settings.
Plays and Last played come from your Last.fm history.
Each time Toasted connects to Roon it reads your artists again (a few seconds), so their pictures and order stay current.
Each artist is looked up on Deezer once; a found picture is kept, and one not found is looked for again after 30 days.

sections.title: What's new
items: Colors has a third choice, Custom, in Toasted's Settings and in Wrapped's Settings. Pick your own accent with the color picker or paste a hex code. The background follows its hue, or pick a background color of your own. The Toaster, the widget, the toasts, Wrapped and Settings all use it.

Now Playing's Background has a Custom choice: a solid color, a gradient (vertical, horizontal, diagonal, reverse diagonal or radial), or an image from your PC. Show the image as Fill, Center or Stretch, or place it yourself: drag it, resize it by its edges and corners, and hold Alt to keep its shape. Blur softens it, and your color shows wherever it doesn't reach. The images you've picked stay in a list to choose from again.
Gives the album art, or your image, a touch of your accent color.
The album art carries on past its edges, mirrored, then softens and fades away. You choose how far it reaches.
Every piece of Now Playing has an Opacity slider, for one piece or all of them at once.
Invert colors is now Tertiary color: Standard, Invert, or Custom, with your own two colors in place of white and the accent.
Roon sometimes stops at the end of a song and never starts the next one. Toasted now moves on to it after a few seconds stuck there. It's on by default, under General in Toasted's Settings.
Every switch in Toasted's Settings is now a pair of buttons, with the On side in your accent color.
Keep shape and Fit to this window moved up next to Show, and the toolbar's groups move to lines of their own in a narrow window. A bar's custom color uses the new color picker.

sections.title: Fixes
items: The toolbar stays on top when you select a piece. Selecting the album art used to cover it.
Escape closes just the picker, not the editor behind it.

sections.title: Good to know
items: Custom backgrounds, Tint, Blur edge, Opacity and Tertiary color are saved with each Now Playing profile.
Skip Stuck Songs works on your Roon zones. Roon ARC's playback isn't shared with apps like Toasted, so it can't help there.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Discover Weekly and Library Rediscover now make themselves every Monday, as promised. They only ever built when you pressed Build now. If your PC is off on Monday, they're made the next time Toasted runs.

sections.title: Good to know
items: A list you've never had is made the next time Toasted starts, not right away, so a tier or the Last.fm key you set up in the meantime is in it from the start. Build now still makes one any time.

sections.title: What's new
items: The Wrapper gets pages of its own. The Wrapped button over Roon's logo, and its side menu, open Home, Discover, Deep Dive, Radio, History and Settings, plus your library: Genres, Artists, Albums, Tracks, Playlists, Listen Later and Tags. Album and artist pages bring similar artists, tags and play menus. Wrapped runs on the Hearts & Library link.

Your Wrapped playlists, your week, artists for you, new albums from the artists you listen to and from ones you may like, newer albums you may have missed, forgotten favorites, and what you played on this day in earlier years.

Discover Weekly (artists you've never played, one song each) and Library Rediscover (favorites you haven't played in a year or more), made every Monday and saved in Roon. Rate a song with the thumbs in the player, and Fine Tuning takes requests in your own words.
Playlists made to order from the songs, albums or artists you pick and what you ask for. Smart Radio needs nothing but the picks.

Discovery gets smarter with each tier you set up in Settings: tier 1 reads Last.fm tags (a free key), tier 2 a language model (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, or Ollama on your own PC), tier 3 listens to the songs. Lights on Discover and Deep Dive show what each tier has.
Everything you've played in Roon, plus your Last.fm scrobbles from before, with your top artists, albums and tracks for any stretch of time.
One Style list for the bars with new waveform looks (Peak caps, Pixel, Stitch, Line graph, Contour), Loudness coloring, and a Wrapped menu with Discover, Deep Dive, the artist and the album.
Discover and Deep Dive sit left of the controls, radio on the left and shuffle and repeat on the right, and the heart right after the song's name.
A short walkthrough the first time you open each part of Wrapped. Replay it or switch it off in Settings.
Default Menu (Wrapped's side menu and Home, or Roon's own, when Wrapped opens), Live albums (off by default: left out of everything Wrapped picks), page size and colors.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Play works on a zone Roon brings back stopped, even when Roon says play isn't allowed.
Roon's sidebar keeps Toasted's colors while you resize or drag the Wrapper.
A Wrapped page that's open when Roon folds its sidebar away now takes the freed space.

sections.title: Good to know
items: Wrapped uses a part of Roon that isn't open to apps, like the hearts, so a Roon update can stop it for a while.
Tiers 2 and 3 are optional. Tier 2 with an online service uses your own key, and the names of songs and artists go to that service.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Resizing the Wrapper could lock it up (Not Responding, tray menu dead, force close needed). Two parts of Toasted were waiting on each other; they no longer can.
The Wrapper could be made shorter than Roon's own minimum, leaving Roon hanging out below the player bar. It now stops at a size that fits Roon.
After a PC restart the zone could show as not ready (play greyed out, Fixed volume, 0:00) until Roon's next change. Zone updates from Roon that carry several changes at once are now read in full.

sections.title: Good to know
items: The Wrapper can go down to about 760 px wide now (Roon folds its sidebar away below about 1400, the hamburger button brings it back). The player bar's seek and volume bars shorten to fit; text, icons and art stay the same.

sections.title: What's new
items: The Roon app inside a Toasted window, with Toasted's player along the bottom, so everything Roon can do is right there. Switch it on in Settings > The Wrapper, then open it from the tray (double-click opens it while it's on), its hotkey (Ctrl+Alt+W) or Settings. Closing it keeps Roon running out of sight, so it reopens instantly.
Gives Roon its own window back. An Enable Wrapper button then sits in Roon's title bar to wrap it up again.
Click the album art in the player bar for a full-window player. Hit the pencil to move and resize the art, track info, controls, seek bar, zone, quality light and volume anywhere you like.

Fonts per piece (bundled or any installed font), icon packs (Lucide, Phosphor, Tabler, Material Symbols, Remix), a plain or circled play button, and bar styles for seek and volume: Line, Thick, Hairline, Segments, Wave, Spectrum, Beam, Glow line, LED meter, Ribbon, Neon tube, Mountains, Particles, Plasma and Album art. Bars can take the app's colors, the album's, or your own. The player bar can follow the same style. With Hearts & Library on, the seek bar can show a local file's real waveform from Roon instead (Waveform: Roon, Pills, Solid shape, Neon outline, LED or Album art, optionally Alive (bouncing gently near the playhead) and colored by loudness), falling back to the bar style when Roon has none.
Save your layouts as profiles and switch between them. Start from the Default, Waves or Waves Large presets.
Only want the Wrapper? Switch the Toaster off in Settings > Toaster, or from the tray. Its hotkeys, links, and toast and widget clicks then open the Wrapper instead.

With Hearts & Library on, a small light shows what's playing as Roon receives it: Low Quality, CD Quality or Hi-Res. Hover it for the name. It sits by the zone in the Wrapper's player bar and the Toaster, and is a piece of its own in Now Playing, where it can also show the file's format next to it (like FLAC 96kHz 24bit 2ch).
With the Wrapper on, the Search hotkey and Stream Deck search can open Roon's own search instead of the Toaster's. Pick Roon or Toaster next to the Search hotkey in Settings > General.
A new Toasted icon in the tray, the taskbar and every title bar, and a Roon: Wrapped logo of its own for the Wrapper.
This window. It opens after each update, and the Changelog button in Settings > Updates brings it back. New settings glow until you hover over them.

sections.title: Good to know
items: The tray menu has Toaster, Wrapper and Taskbar Widget switches. While the Wrapper is on, Open Wrapper comes first and a double-click opens it.
Settings > The Wrapper: Now Playing comes back as you left it, open or closed, even after a restart. Something Roon itself doesn't do.
Settings > The Wrapper and Settings > Toaster: open either one whenever Toasted starts, at sign-in or by hand. On for the Wrapper to begin with.
The Wrapper opens where and at the size you left it (maximized excepted).

Some tracks list a long line of supporting artists. Settings > General > Artists: Main shows just the first one Roon lists, in the Toaster, the Wrapper, toasts, the widget and the queue. On to begin with; All brings the full list back.

A new General card holds what applies to the whole app: Colors, Auto-Hide, Start with Windows and every hotkey. The Hotkeys switch sits on the Hotkeys heading, and the Toaster, Wrapper and Taskbar Widget switches sit next to their titles.
Toasted now looks for an update 10 seconds after it starts (it was a minute), and again when you open Settings if the last look is over 10 minutes old.

sections.title: Fixes
items: On PCs with virtual or VPN network adapters (WSL, Docker, Hyper-V, Tailscale), Toasted could miss the Core until a reboot. It now searches on every network adapter and asks the Core's last known address directly.

sections.title: What's new
items: Settings > Roon Core > Manual: type your Core's IP (and port, if you changed it in Roon) for networks where the search can't get through.
Search looks for Cores again right away. Diagnostics shows what the search sees, with a Copy button for bug reports.

sections.title: What's new
items: Heart the playing track, or add it (or its whole album) to your library, right from the Playing tab.
Albums by the playing artist open in the Toaster, and artist pages split Albums from Singles & EPs.
Toasted checks for new versions and installs them with one click.

sections.title: First release
items: A Roon companion for Windows: now playing, queue, browse and search, now-playing toasts, global hotkeys and a taskbar widget.
